reuse.why: Extends the single existing isNonWorkingDay predicate that every holiday-aware path already calls.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the MM-DD match is added in the one predicate.

placement.why: The change is in shared/schedules.ts in the function that decides whether a day is a holiday.

scope.why: A few lines in one function plus one focused test.

maintainability.why: Minimal, readable change in the one place holidays are matched; only the RecurConfig type comment could mention the new format.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks go through isNonWorkingDay
